items.title: Percy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee mentions 'Basie' only in the context of identifying another musician ('The baritone player with Basie') and later references 'Count Basie's bass player' as an influence on his own playing style, but does not describe a direct personal or professional relationship with Count Basie him
